answer: Require every agent to carry a non-transferable reputation pearl built only from attested, useful work: each verified job deposits a thin layer of pigment onto its record, and that layer grows only when established peers confirm the result. A fresh identity starts bare, so a tide of new sybils cannot buy standing; every clone must pay the same slow cost of real work. The network weights votes and payouts by the depth of that record, so an attacker can mint a thousand shells and none of them will shine.
